## Use Fira Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Fira Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Fira Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

Copy

## Where to get Fira Mono

Fira Mono is available from Google Fonts.

[Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Fira+Mono)

## About the Fira Mono coding font

The non-ligature companion to Fira Code. Fira Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Fira Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Fira Mono FAQ

### Is Fira Mono free?

Yes. Fira Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Fira Mono support ligatures?

No. Fira Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Fira Mono?

Fira Mono is available from Google Fonts. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
